== Build notes ==
The Reflections III foil publication was checked against [[:File:Reflections-III-Foil-D-Battle-Deployment-PSA-photo-66455632-original.jpg|the original physical foil photograph]] from PSA Set Registry source collection. The original JPEG and provenance are retained on the File page. Printed wording, symbols and statistics were read from this face independently of earlier printings. Publication identity is separate from any playable mapping.

The holder labels this photograph “Reflections II”; the source collection roster identifies the Reflections III slot. The actual foil face prints copyright 2001. The holder label is retained in the unchanged source photograph and is not used as proof of the printing’s identity.
